title: Repository convention analysis and local cache
objective: Inspect relevant repository instructions/tooling/conventions, report conflicts without choosing silently, cache source hashes incrementally, and initialize project-only conventions and exact ignore rules.
expected_output: project convention initializer and ignore plan
acceptance_criteria: Analysis covers applicable instructions, templates, scripts, CI, labels, and sampled Git patterns.
Only changed/new source documents are reanalysed; deleted inputs are removed from cache.
Current source files outrank cache; conflicts remain explicit until user resolution.
Project extensions remain outside base Skill; ignore rules do not hide tracked canonical files/config/conventions.
undo_classification: Do not overwrite discovered files; revert only generated, node-owned config/ignore changes after ownership review.
approval_requirements: Approval before writing project config or ignore rules where preview indicates tracked changes.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; stop if source ownership is ambiguous.
